Hi all,

Attached is the current subprocessors roster (redwood_subprocessors_20260803.csv) and a draft DPA amendment (dpa_amendment_draft_20260803.pdf) addressing recent vendor additions. Summary below:

- Cloud infra: AWS (eu-west-1, eu-central-1) — processing occurs in EU regions when the customer selects EU residency. Transfer mechanism: DPA + SCCs in place for cross-border fallbacks.
- CDN: NimbusCDN (EU POPs) — EU-only edge caching enabled for customers who opt into EU residency; otherwise may cache outside EU.
- Observability: Sentry (data-processing only in EU for EU-residency customers) — pseudonymized telemetry may flow to processing outside EU for aggregate analytics; contractually limited to non-identifying telemetry.
- Embeddings datastore: VectorVault (managed partner) — currently processes in EU region; planned replication to US for DR in Q4 (we have flagged as planned addition).
- Payments/Invoices: Stripe (EU legal entity) — processes EU billing data in EU or UK.

Planned additions (next 30 days): VectorVault replication project (will be scoped with EU data controls). We recommend sending Finovate the attached CSV and the DPA amendment draft; the amendment includes an opt-in clause for customers requiring strict EU-only processing.
